[RFCS.4.2] The `StreamHeader` body, and its inline `RealtimeConfig` /
`RealtimeNodeCap` / `RealtimeSeriesCap` companions, are defined in
`proto/stream_header.proto#StreamHeader`. Field 1 is reserved and out of use;
`ds_version` (field 10) is the DS version that wrote the stream, and a reader
accepts its own `<major>.<minor>.` series and rejects every other ([LDET.1.10]).
